description: This file defines the 'Banner' class within the Goteo project, responsible for managing banner entities related to projects, including retrieving, listing, validating, saving, and changing their active state and order.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Represents a banner associated with projects, providing methods to retrieve, list, validate, save, and modify banners within the Goteo project framework.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the language-specific fields for a banner ('title', 'description', 'url').

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific banner by ID, optionally for a specific language, including associated image data.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all banners for a specific node, optionally filtering by active status, with detailed project information.

methods.name: getSocialCommitment
methods.description: Fetches the social commitment associated with the banner's project.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of banners for a given node, suitable for display summaries.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Provides a list of projects available to be highlighted in banners, excluding the current one if specified.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that essential banner fields (project and image) are set.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the banner to the database, handling image uploads and data repletion.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a banner given its ID.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Moves the banner up in display order.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Moves the banner down in display order.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order value for a new banner in a node.
